headline: Committee discusses greenhouse gas emissions goals, a Conservation Law Foundation survey, Earth Month planning, and energy coaching program updates.
summary: The committee will review greenhouse gas emissions data and goals, hear survey results from the Conservation Law Foundation, plan Earth Month activities, and get an update on the Livable Nashua Energy Coaching Program. It will also discuss flooding, combined sewer overflows, and public education on water safety.
items: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Follow-Up: discuss emissions data normalization, additional metrics, and new or adjusted goals
Survey Conducted By Conservation Law Foundation: CLF representative shares survey results on community environmental concerns
Earth Month Planning: discuss potential events, activities, and committee involvement
Livable Nashua Energy Coaching Program Update: application status, outreach efforts, and upcoming activities
Water Safety & Public Awareness: discuss flooding, combined sewer overflows, and public education efforts
